Shader Compatibility

The included Shader Graphs are compatible with both rendering pipelines:

Universal Render Pipeline (URP)
Built-in Render Pipeline

Separate versions of the shaders are provided where required to ensure proper functionality and visual consistency across supported Unity rendering pipelines.

All material customization features, including color customization and mouth expression switching, are available in both pipeline versions.


ShGr_ChibiWitch_Mouth

This Shader Graph is used to control the character's mouth expression by switching between different mouth textures stored in a texture atlas.

Properties: 

Mouth_Index - Mouth_Index changes the UV coordinates of the mouth texture atlas to display different mouth expressions.

Type: Float (Integer values only)
Minimum Value:0
Maximum Value: 9
Default Value: 0

The property is intended to be used with whole-number values only. Each integer value selects a specific mouth texture from the atlas: ChibiWitch\_MouthAtlas

Usage Notes:

-Use integer values only.
-Values outside the supported range are not intended for use.
-The property works by offsetting the UV coordinates within the mouth texture atlas.

ShGr_ChibiWitch_Custom_Colors

This Shader Graph allows customization of the character's color palette through multiple color properties.

Properties:

MainCloth Color - Controls the primary color of the character's clothing.
ClothDetails Color - Controls the color of decorative cloth details and fabric trims located along the edges of the outfit (Decorative fabric edging).
Нair Color - Controls the color of the character's hair.
Skin Color - Controls the color of the character's skin.
AdditionalCloth Color - Controls the color of secondary clothing elements (Boots, The two stitched fabric details on the blouse)
Skirt Color - Controls the color of the character's skirt.


Usage Notes:

-All color properties can be adjusted independently.
-Changes are applied in real time through the material instance.
-Multiple color combinations can be created without modifying the original textures.
